required_content.problem: Durable context can mix snapshots, branches, indexes, caches, authority, taint, revocation, deletion, and recovery obligations while still presenting a clean prompt.
required_content.core_mechanism: A Context Transaction binds an observed causal snapshot, purpose-bound mounts, actual state changes, isolation, durability, visibility, taint, deletion closure, retries, crashes, costs, and residuals.
required_content.worked_trace: A source correction on branch B conflicts with branch C, propagates taint to summary, embedding, cache, and route, invalidates reachable descendants, and leaves an unreachable backup as a residual.
required_content.failure_boundary: Transaction logs, storage commits, logical deletion, access denial, physical erasure, model forgetting, influence removal, privacy protection, and useful context are non-equivalent outcomes.
required_content.evidence_state: The core remains Design rationale at argument support; finite checks cover 3/6 store fixtures, 2/4 event sequences, 78 rejected mutations, and one bounded historical lifecycle.
required_content.non_claims: The visual claims no deployed store, serializability, crash durability, complete cache invalidation, erasure, forgetting, useful memory, transfer, or support promotion.
required_content.handoff: Verification Bandwidth and Context Adequacy next asks whether a valid context view contains enough evidence to justify a claim.
